longTitle.officialTitle: To amend the Public Health Service Act to reauthorize certain poison control programs.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Poison Control Centers Reauthorization Act of 2024”.

subsection.heading: National Toll-Free Number and Other Communication Capabilities.—
subsection.content: Section 1271(c) of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 300d-71(c)) is amended by striking “fiscal years 2020 through 2024” and inserting “fiscal years 2025 through 2029”.

subsection.heading: Promoting Poison Control Center Utilization.—
subsection.content: Section 1272(c) of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 300d-72(c)) is amended by striking “fiscal years 2020 through 2024” and inserting “fiscal years 2025 through 2029”.

subsection.heading: Poison Control Center Grant Program.—
subsection.content: Section 1273(g) of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 300d-73(g)) is amended by striking “fiscal years 2020 through 2024” and inserting “fiscal years 2025 through 2029”.
